label: Keyboard Shortcuts
description: Give your app real keyboard shortcuts. Ships one Keyboard Shortcut node — write the combination on a port ("mod+k", "shift+?", "escape") and wire the Pressed signal wherever you like. "mod" is Command on macOS and Control everywhere else; "cmd" and "ctrl" mean exactly those keys. The listener is registered on mount and removed on unmount, so a shortcut never survives navigating away and fires twice. Shortcuts stay quiet while you are typing in a text field — except Escape and Cmd/Ctrl/Alt chords, which always get through. No dependencies, no network.
